messages.content: Resuelve problemas de palabras paso a paso.
El tren A sale de la ciudad X a 60 km/h hacia el este. El tren B sale de la ciudad Y (300 km al este) a 80 km/h hacia el oeste, 30 minutos después. ¿Cuándo y dónde se encuentran?

message.content:
<think>The user asks: "El tren A sale de la ciudad X a 60 km/h hacia el este. El tren B sale de la ciudad Y (300 km al este) a 80 km/h hacia el oeste, 30 minutos después. ¿Cuándo y dónde se encuentran?" This is a typical relative motion problem. We need to find the time after train A's departure when they meet, and the location (distance from X perhaps). The problem statement: "El tren A sale de la ciudad X a 60 km/h hacia el este. El tren B sale de la ciudad Y (300 km al este) a 80 km/h hacia el oeste, 30 minutos después." So train A starts at X, heading east at 60 km/h. Train B starts at Y, which is 300 km east of X, heading west at 80 km/h, but starts 30 minutes (0.5 hour) later. So they are moving toward each other. They will meet somewhere between X and Y.

We need to find t (time after train A departure) when they meet.

Let t be time after train A departure (in hours). Train A distance traveled = 60 t km.

Train B starts at t = 0.5 h later, so its travel time = t - 0.5 (if t >= 0.5). It travels at 80 km/h, so distance traveled = 80 (t - 0.5) km.

The sum of distances traveled by both equals the initial separation of 300 km (distance between X and Y). So:

60 t + 80 (t - 0.5) = 300.

Solve: 60t + 80t - 40 = 300 => 140 t = 340 => t = 340/140 = 34/14 = 17/7 ≈ 2.428571... hours.

So t ≈ 2.428571 hours after train A departure. That's 2 hours + 0.428571 hours * 60 = 2 hours + 25.714 minutes ≈ 2 hours 25 minutes 43 seconds. Actually 0.428571 hour = 0.428571*60 = 25.714 minutes = 25 minutes + 0.714*60 seconds = 25 minutes + 42.86 seconds ≈ 2 hours 25 minutes 43 seconds.

Thus they meet at t ≈ 2.4286 h after A's departure
